Items.Title: Amped
Items.Description: Increase the VIM generated by all cards by 1 until played this turn. Each point represents duration in number of rounds.

Items.Title: ASSIST
Items.Description:
Effect that remains in combat and is triggered at the start of every turn.
Each turn, its counter decays by 1.
When it expires, the card is moved to the Recycler or is Decompiled accordingly.

Items.Title: AUGMENT COMMANDS
Items.Description: Augmenting a Command refreshes its use and improves its effects. When used, it transforms back to the base Command.

Items.Title: BITE SCRIPT
Items.Description: Script card that deals DMG.

Items.Title: BARRIER
Items.Description: Absorbs incoming DMG. Expires at end of round.

Items.Title: CLOCK
Items.Description: Resource used to play cards.

Items.Title: COCOON SCRIPT
Items.Description: Script card that gives Barrier.

Items.Title: COMMAND
Items.Description: Ability that can be activated by spending VIM.

Items.Title: CONDITIONAL
Items.Description: Additional or alternative effect that triggers if the stated prerequisite is met.

Items.Title: CORRUPTED DATA
Items.Description: CORRUPTED-type card that has no effect and is removed from Repo at end of combat.

Items.Title: CORRUPTED
Items.Description: Harmful card type. Removed from your Repo after combat by default.

Items.Title: Debilitated
Items.Description: Reduces outgoing DMG by 25%. Each point represents duration in number of rounds.

Items.Title: DECOMPILE
Items.Description: Decompiled cards are not reshuffled into your Repo for the remainder of combat.

Items.Title: Depleted
Items.Description: Start your turn drawing 1 fewer card. Each point represents duration in number of rounds.

Items.Title: Exposed
Items.Description: Increases incoming DMG by 25%. Each point represents duration in number of rounds.

Items.Title: Feral
Items.Description: Each point increases outgoing DMG by 5%. Decays one point each turn.

Items.Title: FRAGMENTED DATA
Items.Description: CORRUPTED-type card that has no effect and is Decompiled at end of your turn while in hand.

Items.Title: GENERATOR
Items.Description: VIM generating card type.

Items.Title: Glitched Cards
Items.Description:
Glitched cards suffer a debuff on their Barrier, Damage or VIM output and deal damage to the Runner when played.
This status is removed when the card is played or discarded.

Items.Title: Glitching Matrix
Items.Description: Every time an Attack card is played this turn, it becomes Glitched.

Items.Title: Grit
Items.Description: Each point increases Barrier gained by 5%. Decays one point each turn.

Items.Title: ATTACK CARD
Items.Description: Offensive card type.

Items.Title: Cached
Items.Description: Start your turn drawing 1 extra card. Each point represents duration in number of rounds.

Items.Title: INFECTED DATA
Items.Description: CORRUPTED-type card that deals damage to the Runner and is Decompiled when played.

Items.Title: Overloaded
Items.Description: Generator cards cost 1 extra Clock until played this turn. Each point represents duration in number of rounds.

Items.Title: MAX VIM
Items.Description: Having VIM at maximum capacity (currently 20).

Items.Title: Memory Fumble
Items.Description: At the start of your turn, randomize the base VIM of all cards in hand. Each point represents duration in number of rounds.

Items.Title: Suppressed
Items.Description: Attack cards cost 1 extra Clock until played this turn. Each point represents duration in number of rounds.

Items.Title: ON-DISCARD
Items.Description: Effect that triggers every time the card is discarded during your turn.

Items.Title: ON-HIT CONDITIONAL
Items.Description: An attack is considered to have hit if its DMG impacts the target's Integrity.

Items.Title: Jammed
Items.Description: Can only use 1 Command per turn. Each point represents duration in number of rounds.

Items.Title: PIERCE CORE
Items.Description: Attack card that costs 2 and deals a lot of DMG to the Core Peripheral.

Items.Title: PRESERVE
Items.Description: Preserved cards are not discarded at the end of your turn.

Items.Title: PROTOCOL
Items.Description: Protocol effects stay active once played, while the card disappears until end of combat. Multiple copies of the same Protocol do not stack.

Items.Title: Overclocked
Items.Description: Start your turn with 1 extra Clock. Each point represents duration in number of rounds.

Items.Title: RESOLVE ASSIST
Items.Description: When an Assist effect is resolved, it triggers all its remaining duration counters at once and then expires.

Items.Title: SCRIPT CARDS
Items.Description: Scripts are created by some effects and disappear from the game instead of being discarded or decompiled.

Items.Title: DEFENSE CARD
Items.Description: Defensive card type.

Items.Title: Shutdown
Items.Description: Cannot use Commands this turn. Each point represents duration in number of rounds.

Items.Title: Underclocked
Items.Description: Start your turn with 1 less Clock. Each point represents duration in number of rounds.

Items.Title: Stunned
Items.Description: Skips its next turn.

Items.Title: Tagged
Items.Description: Defense cards cost 1 extra Clock until played this turn. Each point represents duration in number of rounds.

Items.Title: TEMPORARY
Items.Description: Temporary cards disappear from the game instead of being discarded or decompiled.

Items.Title: TEMP VIM
Items.Description: Resource used to activate Commands. Expires at the end of your turn. Does not count for Conditional Effects

Items.Title: HASHKEYS
Items.Description: Resource used to unlock some Gates and Rehash Nodes.

Items.Title: CONCEALER
Items.Description: Install on an empty tile to reduce the Trace cost of every action in that Cluster to 0.

Items.Title: GATEBREAKER
Items.Description: Unlock target Gate.

Items.Title: HARVESTER
Items.Description: Gain 20 Intel. Every time Trace Level increases, increase the Intel yielded by this while in the inventory.

Items.Title: ICEBREAKER
Items.Description: Disable target Watcher, Sentinel or Gate.

Items.Title: LOG SCRUBBER
Items.Description: Reduce Trace by 4.

Items.Title: LOG WIPER
Items.Description: Reduce Trace to 0.

Items.Title: REFRESHER
Items.Description: Refresh your Skills.

Items.Title: SCOUT PROBE
Items.Description: Reveal an area in the Grid.

Items.Title: SENTINEL-BREAKER
Items.Description: Disable a Sentinel.

Items.Title: TELEPORTER
Items.Description: Teleport to a random Cluster (prioritizes unrevealed).

Items.Title: INTEL
Items.Description: Resource used to buy cards, tools and more.

Items.Title: TRIGGER ASSIST
Items.Description: When an Assist effect is triggered outside of the start of your turn, it does its effect without reducing its duration counter.

Items.Title: Unstable
Items.Description: Decrease the VIM generated by all cards by 1 until played this turn. Each point represents duration in number of rounds.

Items.Title: Untargetable
Items.Description: This entity cannot be targeted by single target attacks.

Items.Title: VIM (VIRTUAL MEMORY)
Items.Description: Resource used to activate Commands.

Items.Title: WEAVE SCRIPT
Items.Description: Script card that draws a card and generate VIM.

Items.Title: RECYCLER
Items.Description: Contains the cards that will be reshuffled into your Repo next time you need to draw from it and it's empty.

Items.Title: REPOSITORY
Items.Description: Contains the cards left to draw from.
